description: Flowton is a tool to track Productive vs. Unproductive time. When you have a goal, you want to do more of one thing and less of another. This is often what truly moves the needle. For example, did you spend 4 hours studying yesterday or only 2? Did you spend 5 hours gaming or just 1? This app lets you rethink your whole day as Up time or Down time activities, track them to see where your time really goes, what the ratio is, and where to improve.
